quote: Yeah. Yeah. I'm still interested. That kind of thing.
stewart_read: Gary self-identifies as still interested unprompted at the very start of the call — a gift Joel doesn't need to work for.
coaching_implication: Joel could reflect this back explicitly ('glad to hear that, let's get you set back up') to build rapport before moving straight to scheduling.

quote: I want a security system put in.
stewart_read: This isn't scope creep by Joel, but it is an unmanaged tangent — Gary derails into an unrelated topic and Joel doesn't redirect back to solar qualification.
alternative_hypothesis: Joel may have judged interrupting an 82-year-old customer's rambling as worse for rapport than letting it run.
coaching_implication: A short bridge line ('that's a good project — let's make sure we get your solar info squared away too') would have redirected without being rude.

quote: solar stuff, you know, I I I think it's probably a good idea. You know? Yeah. Especially if you're just trying to save money.
stewart_read: This is the customer volunteering the exact hook (saving money) that verify.interest_in_solar is built to capture, and Joel gives a one-line generic reply instead of expanding it.
coaching_implication: Should have followed with 'what's your bill running you currently?' to convert this into the bill anchor — never happened anywhere in the call.

quote: I want it on the on my outbuildings, you know, and, that type of thing.
stewart_read: Gary describes a specific, non-standard system scope (outbuildings, separate transformer, battery interest) — a strong qualification and cross-sell signal.
coaching_implication: This detail (off-house structure, existing transformer routing, battery interest) should be logged for the closer verbatim; it wasn't captured as a verify item at all.

quote: there's a place for batteries and and all that kind of stuff over there too if it takes that kind of thing.
stewart_read: Gary explicitly raises battery storage (Ion sells Tesla Powerwall) and Joel gives no acknowledgment or bridge to that offering in the transcript.
coaching_implication: A quick 'we do offer battery backup with Tesla Powerwall, the specialist can go over that with you' would validate and set up the closer.

quote: I'll just send you a text. I'll send you a text saying Okay. Hey. It's Joel with Ion. We'll see you tomorrow, 9AM.
stewart_read: Joel commits to texting but never runs a full button-up (one-hour block, no-driving/computer instruction, verbal fairness handshake).
coaching_implication: Button-up should include the standard elements even on a rescheduled/warm lead — this appointment is booked on tone, not on locked procedure.
